title: Book 5: Burnout Hiatus, Our Own Frequency & Neon on the Huckleberry Trail (2005–2014)
description: Ten quiet years at home on Progress Street NE: recording 2008's intimate acoustic living-room album Our Own Frequency, becoming $30/month non-resident members at the Town of Christiansburg's Blue Ridge Regional Aquatic Center, turning down a $150,000,000 corporate catalog buyout, and getting the inspiration for 'Neon on the Huckleberry Trail' at 5:30 PM on an October evening in 2014.
